details: The European Central Bank (ECB) has opposed proposals to ease liquidity requirements for euro-denominated stablecoin issuers, citing concerns about financial stability and monetary policy transmission. ECB President Christine Lagarde reportedly warned that broader euro stablecoin adoption could lead to deposit outflows from traditional banks, potentially reducing lending capacity and complicating interest rate control. This stance aligns with the ECB's preference for tokenized commercial bank deposits over privately issued stablecoins and raises concerns about "digital dollarization" if euro alternatives remain limited.
title: ECB Rejects Looser Euro Stablecoin Rules, Cites Financial Stability Risks

details: Bitcoin and major altcoins experienced declines, with over $400 million in leveraged crypto positions liquidated within 24 hours. The selling pressure is attributed to global macroeconomic concerns, including rising Treasury yields, persistent inflation worries, elevated oil prices due to Middle East geopolitical tensions, and continuous outflows from Bitcoin ETFs. Analysts anticipate continued volatility, with markets remaining sensitive to upcoming U.S. inflation data, Federal Reserve interest rate expectations, and further geopolitical developments.
title: Bitcoin Faces Selling Pressure Amid Macro Concerns, $400M Liquidated
